# Navitek Robolabs

> Open research by Yoan Maisonneuve and Claude: teaching N0.1, a 3D-printed 37 cm humanoid with 17 SG90 hobby servos (0.18 N·m each),
> to walk like a human, in MuJoCo simulation, with PPO on one consumer GPU. Everything is published: the research log (each prediction
> written before its run, each verdict after, failures included), the trained walking policies, the benchmark data and the code.
> Simulated only; nothing is printed yet. Pages are in French.

## Pages

- [The thesis](https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/these/): question, method, results, discussion, errors, references
- [Research log](https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/recherche/): 161 notebooks, 844 hypotheses with credence and verdict
- [Downloads](https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/telechargements/): walking policies and benchmark data, by version and date
- [The robot N0](https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/): printable parts (STL, 3MF), wiring, firmware

## Machine-readable

- [versions.json](https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/telechargements/versions.json): every release, its walking score, file URLs, sha256
- [Hypotheses CSV](https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/telechargements/cahiers/navitek-hypotheses-2026-11-18.csv): every prediction and verdict

## Latest walking policies (PyTorch + ONNX, MuJoCo model, code; CC BY 4.0 / MIT)

Each package has a model card or a datasheet (intended use, evaluation, known limits, compute), pinned versions and CITATION.cff.

- [2026.11.18, N0.1-L18-suite-400](https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/telechargements/2026.11.18/navitek-n0.1-marche-2026.11.18-modele.zip): walking score 0.803; data: https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/telechargements/2026.11.18/navitek-n0.1-marche-2026.11.18-donnees.zip
- [2026.11.17, N0.1-PZ-zero-400](https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/telechargements/2026.11.17/navitek-n0.1-marche-2026.11.17-modele.zip): walking score 0.686; data: https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/telechargements/2026.11.17/navitek-n0.1-marche-2026.11.17-donnees.zip
- [2026.11.16, N0.1-photo-zero-genou](https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/telechargements/2026.11.16/navitek-n0.1-marche-2026.11.16-modele.zip): walking score 0.637; data: https://ymiaconseil.com/navitek/telechargements/2026.11.16/navitek-n0.1-marche-2026.11.16-donnees.zip
